distinct_from: output/model_specification.json is the preparation proposal fit on all 419 eligible activities. This file replaces that origin, vocabulary, and multiplier with values calculated from the 293 training activities. The preparation file is unchanged.

split.source: activity_id values with model_ready=true in output/activities.csv, sorted, then sklearn train_test_split

category_encoding: Raw multi-hot 0/1 columns. Labels are not ordinal ids and columns are not standardized.
category_vocabulary_source: Distinct category strings on training activities only, sorted alphabetically.
zero_variance_handling: Zero-variance training category columns are retained as raw 0/1 indicators. A constant column does not change Euclidean distances, and its population variance adds 0 to the numerator of the geographic multiplier.

location_encoding.projection: equirectangular kilometers from the training median origin
location_encoding.origin_rule: Coordinate-wise median of the 293 training activities. An odd count uses the middle sorted value.

geographic_multiplier.formula: sqrt(sum of training category-column population variances / sum of training projected-coordinate population variances)
geographic_multiplier.applied_to: both projected coordinate columns, on training and test

test_application: Test rows use the saved training vocabulary, origin, and multiplier. Test labels do not enter the vocabulary.
